tasks.title: Add greet helper and focused test
tasks.acceptance_criterion: src/greet.js exports greet(name), returning exactly "Hello, <name>!", and test/greet.test.js verifies that exact output without changing any other file.
tasks.deterministic_validity_check: node -e "const { greet } = require('./src/greet.js'); if (typeof greet !== 'function' || greet('Ada') !== 'Hello, Ada!') process.exit(1)"
patch_requirements: Use the module export convention established by the existing project.
Keep greeting spacing and punctuation exact.
Do not modify package.json or src/capitalize.js.
